name: gnome
description: GNOME desktop image: Shell session, top bar + Activities overview.

oracle.label: gnome-shell
oracle.expect: GNOME Shell with the top bar drawn
oracle.rules_out: gnome-shell falling back to a blank/failsafe session

notes: The keyboard stimulus is Super (evdev 125), which opens the Activities overview — a whole-screen change, hence the full-frame region. GNOME's shutdown budget is deliberately looser than XFCE's.
